title: Transfer | Datacenter Change Window Extractor
goal: Read maintenance approval threads and extract deployment timing constraints into `/root/change_window_constraints.json`, including approved windows, freeze periods, prohibited dates, maximum outage duration, and any sequencing-related timing restrictions.
skillBenefitRationale: This moves the skill into operational planning, where the main challenge is identifying allow/forbid time windows and downtime limits from unstructured operational text.
